limitation: Untreated covariates and stable counterfactual relationship are essential
inspection: Primary README/license/package or repository metadata; selected API source where saved. No runtime package benchmark.
pin_limit: Content hashes pin actual saved artifacts. Retrieved HEAD, if present, is a separate observation; mutable-branch files are not asserted to belong to that commit.

scientific_qualification.input: A treated outcome series, a pre/post intervention split and unaffected control series.
scientific_qualification.output: Posterior counterfactual series and intervention contrasts conditional on the structural time-series model.
scientific_qualification.assumptions: Controls are unaffected by treatment; the pre-period outcome/control relation extends to the untreated post-period and competing shocks are accounted for.
scientific_qualification.adapter_rule: Register donor/control exposure and the intervention date. Do not interpret posterior predictive fit or interval width as a test of no spillovers or stable counterfactual extrapolation.
scientific_qualification.acceptance_test: Simulate a known campaign shock, then contaminate controls and introduce a post-period coefficient break; check model-conditional effects and failure diagnostics.

evidence.finding: Structural time-series target, unaffected-control and stable-relationship assumptions.
